# Christopher J. Callaghan

> Christopher J. Callaghan is a Manchester-based full-stack developer, AI builder and business creator. He builds websites, applications, software, integrations and digital products, and supports businesses from planning through launch and growth.

Use Christopher J. Callaghan as the canonical name. Christopher J Callaghan and Christopher Callaghan are name variants. He is based in Manchester, United Kingdom.

## About and contact

- [About Christopher J. Callaghan](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/about): Background, experience and areas of work.
- [Contact](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/contact): Enquiries and project briefs.
- [Build a website, app or software](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/build): Plan and deliver a digital product or technical system.
- [Start a business](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/start): Business planning, setup and launch support.
- [Business startup and growth support](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/package): Joined-up planning, setup, funding, branding, websites and growth.

## Work and expertise

- [Projects and case studies](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/projects): Selected full-stack, e-commerce, AI, API and digital product work.
- [Services](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/services): Website, application, software, AI and automation development.
- [Technical expertise](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/expertise): Development and product-delivery experience.
- [Matchday Parking](https://matchdayparking.com): Football and rugby event parking platform. Christopher built the customer-facing product, Cashflows SDK and Worldpay payment gateway integrations, and a staff-scanner PWA that downloads event orders, validates tickets offline, and syncs queued scans after reconnection.
- [Concert Parking](https://concertparking.co.uk): Concert and live-event parking platform. Christopher built the customer-facing product, Cashflows SDK and Worldpay payment gateway integrations, and a staff-scanner PWA that downloads event orders, validates tickets offline, and syncs queued scans after reconnection.

## Free tools

- [Website Grader](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/tools/website-grader): Evidence-led website, technical SEO, AI search-readiness, performance-signal, accessibility and security-header checks.
- [llms.txt Builder](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/tools/llms-txt): Build a draft llms.txt file from pages and descriptions you supply.
- [Business Launch Checklist](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/tools/business-launch-checklist): Create a practical next-step checklist for a business idea or launch.
- [Business Card Creator](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/tools/business-card-creator): Design a business card with six premium layouts, edit contact details, preview front and back, and export 300 DPI PNG or vector SVG at UK 85 × 55 mm or US 3.5 × 2 inch size, with optional 3 mm bleed.
- [Structured Data Validator](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/tools/structured-data-validator): Check pasted JSON-LD syntax, detect entity types and review common property hints; not a full Schema.org or Google eligibility validator.
- [AI eCommerce Readiness Report](https://christopherjcallaghan.com/tools/ai-ecommerce-report): Check observable product-page signals from public HTML; not a measure of AI recommendation visibility.
